name: Software Engineering Pack
description: Inspects software repositories, runs declared npm scripts, and validates task contracts. First real capability pack, extracted from the v0.3 seed.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Inspects a software repository: counts source files, tests, scripts, and dependencies without modifying anything.

actions.name: verify
actions.description: Runs selected declared npm scripts and reports pass/fail/blocked status for each.

actions.name: validate-task
actions.description: Validates a domain-neutral task contract against the schema.
